name: Leaving Church
overview: Scripture affirms the enduring foundation of the church, established by Christ on the 'rock' of Peter, promising that the gates of hell will not overcome it. However, believers are also warned to be vigilant against those who cause divisions and distort the gospel, as such individuals threaten the unity and purity of the church. In response, Christians are instructed to avoid those who pervert the gospel, underscoring the importance of steadfast faithfulness to true doctrine within the community of believers.
